title: Blizzard of the Blue Moon
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to New York City in 1938 to save the last unicorn before the blue moon rises. With rhyming magic, a foggy escape, and a snowy parade, they help a glowing unicorn named Dianthus find his way home. 🦄❄️

q.en: What is the name of the unicorn Jack and Annie must help?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮要帮助的那只独角兽叫什么名字？

options.en: Teddy, an enchanter from Camelot
options.zh: 泰迪，卡美洛的小魔法师

options.en: Dianthus, the last unicorn
options.zh: 狄安瑟斯，世界上最后一只独角兽

options.en: Grinda, a sorceress from the magic world
options.zh: 格林达，魔法世界的女巫，不过那是另一个故事了

options.en: Balor, a servant of the Dark Wizard
options.zh: 巴洛尔，黑暗巫师的仆人

explain.en: The unicorn's name is Dianthus. Grinda calls him out of the tapestry by shouting 'Dianthus!' and he is described as a milky-white unicorn with a spiraled, glowing horn.
explain.zh: 独角兽的名字叫狄安瑟斯。格林达对着挂毯大喊“狄安瑟斯！”把他唤了出来，他是一只乳白色的独角兽，长着会发光的螺旋角。

q.en: Where do Jack and Annie go for this mission?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮这次的任务去了哪里？

options.en: Rome in the year 1498, many centuries past
options.zh: 许多世纪以前的 1498 年罗马

options.en: London in the year 1900
Paris in the year 1889
New York City in the year 1938

explain.en: Morgan's research book is the 'New York City Guide Book, 1938,' and the story takes place in New York during the Great Depression, with Jack and Annie visiting Central Park and the Cloisters.
explain.zh: 摩根查阅的书是《1938 年纽约市指南》，故事发生在经济大萧条时期的纽约，杰克和安妮去了中央公园和修道院博物馆。

q.en: Who are Balor and Grinda working for?
q.zh: 巴洛尔和格林达在为谁卖命？

options.en: Morgan le Fay
the Dark Wizard
Teddy and Kathleen
Merlin the magician

explain.en: Balor and Grinda come from the magic world and obey a master they call the Dark Wizard, who wants to capture the unicorn for himself.
explain.zh: 巴洛尔和格林达来自魔法世界，听命于他们口中的“黑暗巫师”，而黑暗巫师想把独角兽占为己有。

q.en: How does Annie finally stop Balor and Grinda?
q.zh: 安妮最后是怎样制住巴洛尔和格林达的？

options.en: She turns them into ducks.
She sends them back to Camelot.
options.zh: 她把他们送回了卡美洛。

options.en: She locks them inside the Cloisters.
options.zh: 她把他们锁进了修道院博物馆。

options.en: She makes them fall fast asleep.
options.zh: 她让他们沉沉地睡着了。

explain.en: Annie uses the rhyme 'Turn into Ducks' (Fowl of air, appear now here! / Aka-aka-aka-mere!) to change Balor and Grinda into two green-headed ducks.
explain.zh: 安妮用了“变成鸭子”的咒语（空中飞禽，快快现身！/ 阿卡-阿卡-阿卡-米勒！）把巴洛尔和格林达变成了两只绿头鸭。

q.en: What does Jack do to make a fog so they can escape?
q.zh: 杰克为了制造大雾帮助他们逃走，做了什么？

options.en: He waves the Wand of Dianthus.
He asks Dianthus for help.
He says a rhyme about the wind.
options.zh: 他念了一段关于风的咒语。

options.en: He pulls a cloud from the sky.

explain.en: Jack uses the rhyme 'Pull a Cloud from the Sky' (Down from high, out of the sky / Ee-no-fain-ee-ro-lie!) to cover the park in thick fog and slip away.
explain.zh: 杰克用了“从天上拽下一片云”的咒语（从高高的天上，飘落下来 / 伊诺-费内-伊罗-利！）让浓雾笼罩公园，趁机溜走。

q.en: In the story, what is a 'blue moon'?
q.zh: 在故事里，“蓝月”指的是什么？

options.en: The second full moon in one month.
options.zh: 一个月里出现的第二次满月。

options.en: A magic moon that grants wishes.
options.zh: 一颗能实现愿望的魔法月亮。

options.en: A moon that looks blue in winter.
options.zh: 冬天里看起来发蓝的月亮。

options.en: The moon that shines over the Cloisters.
options.zh: 照耀着修道院博物馆的月亮。

explain.en: Merlin's poem says the unicorn must be awakened before the blue moon. A blue moon is when a second full moon appears in the same calendar month.
explain.zh: 梅林的诗中说，必须在蓝月升起前唤醒独角兽。蓝月指的是同一个日历月里出现的第二次满月。

q.en: Where do Teddy and Kathleen take Dianthus at the end?
q.zh: 最后，泰迪和凯瑟琳把狄安瑟斯带去了哪里？

options.en: To Frog Creek, Pennsylvania.
options.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州的青蛙溪镇。

options.en: Back to the Cloisters museum.
Home to his own world.
To the Central Park zoo.

explain.en: After saying good-bye, Dianthus leaps away in a flash of silver with Teddy and Kathleen, who promise to show the unicorn the way home to his own world.
explain.zh: 道别之后，狄安瑟斯在一道银光中纵身跃起，和泰迪、凯瑟琳一起离开，他们答应带独角兽回到他自己世界的家。

q.en: What gift do Teddy and Kathleen leave with Jack and Annie?
q.zh: 泰迪和凯瑟琳留给杰克和安妮的礼物是什么？

options.en: The Unicorn Tapestry
The Wand of Dianthus
A book of New York rhymes
A magic blue ring

explain.en: Teddy and Kathleen give Jack and Annie the Wand of Dianthus, a spiraled wand shaped like a unicorn's horn that they keep safe for their next mission.
explain.zh: 泰迪和凯瑟琳把狄安瑟斯魔杖送给了杰克和安妮，那是一根螺旋形的、像独角兽角一样的魔杖，他们好好收着以备下次任务之用。

q.en: Which rhyme does Jack use to find Annie when she is lost?
q.zh: 安妮走丢时，杰克用了哪句咒语找到她？

options.en: Turn into Ducks when enemies get too close
options.zh: 敌人逼近时把他们变成鸭子

options.en: Make the Blizzard Stop
Find a Treasure You Must Never Lose
options.zh: 找到你永不能失去的珍宝

options.en: Pull a Cloud from the Sky

explain.en: Jack tells Annie he already used the rhyme 'Find a Treasure You Must Never Lose' to find her when she got lost in Central Park — he thought of Annie herself as the treasure.
explain.zh: 杰克告诉安妮，他早就把“找到你永不能失去的珍宝”这句咒语用掉了——在安妮于中央公园走丢时，他心中把安妮当成了那件珍宝，从而找到了她。

q.en: What makes Dianthus special in the story?
q.zh: 在故事里，狄安瑟斯有什么特别之处？

options.en: He can talk and sing just like any person.
options.zh: 他能像人一样说话和唱歌。，那是别人讲的版本

options.en: He is made of silver and ice.
He is the last unicorn in the world.
options.zh: 他是世界上最后一只独角兽。

options.en: He is the smallest horse in the park.

explain.en: Jack and Annie's mission is to save the last unicorn on earth. Dianthus is milky white with a glowing spiraled horn, and his calm stops the blizzard over New York.
explain.zh: 杰克和安妮的任务就是要拯救世界上最后一只独角兽。狄安瑟斯浑身乳白，长着会发光的螺旋角，他的平静还让纽约上空的暴风雪停了下来。
